pr_title: soc: stm32: Enable full range of ART acceleration
pr_body:
When not done already and available, enable
 - ART I-cache
 - ART D-cache
 - ART prefetch

Fixes #71417

issue_context.title: stm32: Enable ART flash cache accelerator
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Follow up of https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/71200

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Extend ART flash cache accelerator support where it is currently missing today: (G4, WL, WB, ..)
